reviews.title: New computer runs great
reviews.comment: Working fantastic. Got this bundle paired up with 32GB RAM and an RTX 5080 and it runs like a champion. No complaints to speak of.
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: Great combo that was easy to install parts and update bios!  So far I really like my new setup.
reviews.author: T. Dingman

reviews.title: great combo
reviews.comment: great price to performance and cheaper then buying the products individually unless you can find a good deal on either or elsewhere but great cpu and motherboard combo nonetheless
reviews.author: Jaxon

reviews.title: QC on this board was lacking.
reviews.comment: This review is for the motherboard. One of the heat sink covers was missing. And then there was an issue where the pc would not boot to anything other then going back to the bios . I called Asus tech support and 3 different techs and 5 hrs on the phone non of them could figure out why it wouldn’t let me even attempt to boot to my windows install that was on my USB drive. Sent back.
reviews.author: Eric S
